thread:
Ava (CS): FYI Lumina onboarding is stalling their embedding jobs show mismatched lengths and 422s from the dedupe preprocessor since ~09:03 PT. Customer reports their trial index is blocked. Need quick mitigation + customer note.
Diego (SRE): Confirmed dedupe service returning inconsistent shard responses after a config flip at 08:58. Rolling back config now; should be back within 12-15m.
Pri (AE): Lumina is a pilot, 30 seats, renewal talk in 5 months. We should offer an option to finish their current batch via hosted pipeline to avoid losing momentum.
Support: INC-5120 created, severity P2, linking infra + cs + ae.
Diego (SRE): Rollback completed at 09:17 PT. Deduper stabilized but backlog persists and a few jobs already failed. I can enable a temporary host-routing for project LM-77 to reprocess failed requests; ETA 10m.
Ava (CS): Draft to customer: "Hi Tara  we're sorry for the interruption. We've stabilized the dedupe service and can re-run your stalled batch via our hosted pipeline immediately to clear backlog, or pause if you prefer. We'll also provide a goodwill credit and a 1:1 enablement session. Which do you prefer?"
Tara (Lumina): Please re-run via hosted pipeline, thanks. We need the data in place for our demo next week. Also please confirm any logs retained.
Diego (SRE): Hosted re-run enabled at 09:30 PT for LM-77; success rate up to 96% within 6 minutes. Confirmed no customer plaintext persisted in logs.
Ava (CS): Noted. CS follow-ups: (1) apply $1,000 credit once impact window validated, (2) schedule 30-min enablement to confirm demo readiness, (3) update renewal-risk flag to medium until onboarding completes.
Rae (RevOps): Tagged LM-77 in churn-watch and logged incident summary to weekly. Please capture failed job count and duration for credit calc.
Sam (Support): I'll collect request-ids for failed jobs and share to Lumina + SRE. Also scheduled a check-in message in 24h.
Diego (SRE): RCA draft: root cause = config flip on deduper leading to inconsistent shard hashing; mitigations = pre-deploy hashing verification, canary config gating, and playbook for hosted re-run. Posting doc by EOD.
Ava (CS): Thanks everyone. Once RCA posted I'll send the technical appendix and confirm scheduling for the enablement session. Closing internal loop after credit applied and onboarding confirmed.
notes: deduper config flip, hosted re-run fallback, credit + enablement, renewal risk tagging
